generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The error message for type incompatibility is slightly inconsistent: it uses the type name string for the match field (`fieldType.typeName()`) but passes the `inputDataType` object directly to the string concatenation, which relies on its `toString()` implementation. For better clarity in logs, consider using `inputDataType.typeName()` to ensure both sides of the comparison are presented identically.

The logic for identifying lookup indices contains an acknowledged limitation regarding RIGHT joins (as noted in the TODO). Since this affects how concrete indices are filtered and subsequently how the execution plan is validated in `ComputeService`, this represents a functional gap that should be addressed to ensure full support for all join types.

review_comment: FTR: we want to get field extraction on the right side as well at some point.

The field extraction is implicitly done inside the `LookupFromIndexService`. I agree it'd be nicer to make the field extraction visible in the physical plan; currently, that'd have no benefit, though, because we cannot really materialize fields late - all looked up fields need to be extracted inside the `LookupFromIndexService`.

It'd require a fundamental change of the execution to extract additional fields _after_ the execution of the lookup join.
